# Versions of: Programmatic stories

2 published versions of [Programmatic stories: how the PrompTugal bulletins went from a 30-second text bulletin to twelve synthetic presenters on one 3D stage in two days, movies made by code instead of rendered by hand, every frame a function of time and data, what that makes possible, from live data and real voices to an animated summary for every article, the story of how Vicky Wang ran her agents, a morning briefing I would actually watch, and an invitation to filmmakers](../programmatic-stories.md). The current one is **v1.1.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
